items.title: Where does your curve actually bend?
items.description: Weekly net output as hours worked increases, with a fatigue penalty that grows the further hours climb past a 50-hour baseline. Drag 'fatigue sensitivity' up to model more error-prone, high-stakes work (bends earlier) or down to model routine, low-stakes work (bends later).
items.compute: const h = params.hoursPerWeek; const k = params.fatigueSensitivity; const penalty = Math.max(0, h - 50); const weeklyOutput = h - (k / 100) * penalty * penalty; const linearOutput = h; return { weeklyOutput: Math.max(0, weeklyOutput), linearOutput };
